character: Tight, twisty circuit dubbed 'Monaco without the walls' — low average speed, high downforce, and few overtaking opportunities. Rewards precision and mid-corner rotation over outright straight-line speed.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.technique: Firm braking on the uphill approach, late apex to set up Turn 2
corners.trap: Running wide compromises the tight Turn 2 entry

corners.name: Turn 4
corners.technique: Patient trail brake, low speed, precise placement
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed and running wide on exit

corners.name: Turn 11-12
corners.technique: Smooth, rhythmic direction changes, carry momentum through both parts
corners.trap: Over-driving the first part upsets the whole sequence

corners.name: Turn 13-14
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit is critical — feeds the pit straight
corners.trap: Compromised exit costs time down the entire straight
